name: Palatka
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Palatka, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Palatka, FL: the 115th Christmas Parade, the Putnam County tree lighting and Putnam's Festival of Lights.
lede: Palatka starts Christmas on the Friday after Thanksgiving with a courthouse tree lighting, Santa and a 115th annual parade, then returns in December for a fairgrounds light show.
celebrates: Palatka's Christmas begins downtown on the Friday after Thanksgiving. Putnam County lights its tree on the courthouse lawn, Santa is at the courthouse before and after the parade, and the City of Palatka's Christmas Parade rolls along St. Johns Avenue, with Downtown Palatka Experiences hosting. Two weeks later, Putnam's Festival of Lights turns the Putnam County Fairgrounds in East Palatka into a winter wonderland with ice skating, Santa's Workshop, a s'mores fire pit and a Christmas carousel. The Putnam County Fairgrounds list tickets for the festival online, and Visit Palatka carries the parade and festival listings for the area.
lastyear: The Putnam County Chamber's 2025 holiday article listed the Palatka Christmas Parade on November 28 and described the first Putnam's Festival of Lights with ice skating, food and a $10 admission, free for ages 4 and under. Visit Palatka calls this year's festival a return after a successful debut and its second year. The 2026 parade is the 115th, which means the 2025 parade was the 114th.
facts: The City of Palatka's calendar calls this the 115th annual Christmas Parade, held on St. Johns Avenue in downtown Palatka. Putnam's Festival of Lights is at the Putnam County Fairgrounds, 118 Fairgrounds Road in East Palatka, which has its own ZIP code, 32131. Visit Palatka lists parade entry fees of $5 each or three for $10 for groups that want to march.
trains: Palatka's 2026 listings do not include a train ride. The closest railroad museum entry on our site is the Jacksonville terminal page, and our Jacksonville guide covers trains and light shows in the city. At Putnam's Festival of Lights the fairgrounds list a Christmas carousel as new for 2026, a ride children can pick instead, alongside the bigger skating rink and a s'mores fire pit.
train_links: The closest train museum page on our site, in Jacksonville.
traditions: The county lights its tree on the courthouse lawn.
The 115th annual parade on St. Johns Avenue.
Santa is at the courthouse before and after the parade.
Lights, skating, Santa's Workshop, s'mores and a carousel at the fairgrounds.
kidfact: The Palatka Christmas Parade is the 115th annual, so children have been watching it roll down St. Johns Avenue for more than a century.
faq: The 2026 listings put the courthouse tree lighting and the Christmas Parade on the Friday after Thanksgiving, and Putnam's Festival of Lights in the second week of December.
Is the Palatka Christmas Parade free?
Yes. The City of Palatka's community calendar lists it as free.
Where do we see Santa in Palatka?
Visit Palatka lists Santa at the Putnam County Courthouse before and after the parade, and the Festival of Lights has Santa's Workshop.
Where is Putnam's Festival of Lights?
At the Putnam County Fairgrounds, 118 Fairgrounds Road, East Palatka, with tickets sold online.
sources: Hometown Holidays: Christmas Fun in Putnam County, FL
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Palatka for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Putnam County Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony and the 115th Palatka Christmas Parade) through December 13, with Putnam's Festival of Lights at the Putnam County Fairgrounds (December 10 to 13) closing the season. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Palatka

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Palatka
  • 1 free event: the 115th Palatka Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the Putnam County Courthouse before and after the parade, and Santa's Workshop at the Festival of Lights
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Putnam County Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony and the 115th Palatka Christmas Parade
  • Trains: none listed; the Festival of Lights has a Christmas carousel and a skating rink
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 13, 2026
